violation_type.title: AP Report a Child In Care Showing Signs and Symptoms of Illness Requiring Hospitalization (26 TAC §747.303(a)(3))
violation_type.short_title: AP Report a Child In Care Showing Signs and Symptoms of Illness Requiring Hospitalization
violation_type.typical_finding: The provider reported an incident involving a child who was transported to the hospital and received medical treatment five days after the incident occurred.

finding_variants.text: The provider reported an incident involving a child who was transported to the hospital and received medical treatment five days after the incident occurred.
